CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hybrid_search(query_text text, query_embedding bytea, vector_weight double precision, text_weight double precision, k integer, model_name text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, text text, vector_score double precision, text_score double precision, combined_score double precision, season integer, episode integer, scene integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
                    BEGIN
                        RETURN QUERY
                        WITH vector_results AS (
                            -- Vector search
                            SELECT 
                                nc.id,
                                nc.raw_text AS text,
                                1 - (ce.embedding <=> query_embedding::vector) AS raw_score,
                                (1 - (ce.embedding <=> query_embedding::vector)) * vector_weight AS vector_score,
                                cm.season,
                                cm.episode,
                                cm.scene
                            FROM 
                                narrative_chunks nc
                            JOIN 
                                chunk_embeddings ce ON nc.id = ce.chunk_id
                            LEFT JOIN
                                chunk_metadata cm ON nc.id = cm.chunk_id
                            WHERE
                                ce.model = model_name
                            ORDER BY 
                                ce.embedding <=> query_embedding::vector
                            LIMIT 
                                k * 2
                        ),
                        text_results AS (
                            -- Text search
                            SELECT 
                                nc.id,
                                nc.raw_text AS text,
                                ts_rank(to_tsvector('english', nc.raw_text), 
                                      plainto_tsquery('english', query_text)) AS raw_score,
                                ts_rank(to_tsvector('english', nc.raw_text), 
                                      plainto_tsquery('english', query_text)) * text_weight AS text_score,
                                cm.season,
                                cm.episode,
                                cm.scene
                            FROM 
                                narrative_chunks nc
                            LEFT JOIN
                                chunk_metadata cm ON nc.id = cm.chunk_id
                            WHERE 
                                to_tsvector('english', nc.raw_text) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', query_text)
                            ORDER BY
                                ts_rank(to_tsvector('english', nc.raw_text), 
                                      plainto_tsquery('english', query_text)) DESC
                            LIMIT 
                                k * 2
                        ),
                        combined_results AS (
                            -- Combine and deduplicate results
                            SELECT 
                                COALESCE(v.id, t.id) AS id,
                                COALESCE(v.text, t.text) AS text,
                                COALESCE(v.vector_score, 0) AS vector_score,
                                COALESCE(t.text_score, 0) AS text_score,
                                COALESCE(v.vector_score, 0) + COALESCE(t.text_score, 0) AS combined_score,
                                COALESCE(v.season, t.season) AS season,
                                COALESCE(v.episode, t.episode) AS episode,
                                COALESCE(v.scene, t.scene) AS scene
                            FROM 
                                vector_results v
                            FULL OUTER JOIN 
                                text_results t ON v.id = t.id
                        )
                        SELECT *
                        FROM combined_results
                        ORDER BY combined_score DESC
                        LIMIT k;
                    END;
                    $function$

 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, text text, vector_score double precision, text_score double precision, combined_score double precision, season integer, episode integer, scene integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
                    BEGIN
                        RETURN QUERY
                        WITH vector_results AS (
                            -- Vector search
                            SELECT 
                                nc.id,
                                nc.raw_text AS text,
                                1 - (ce.embedding <=> query_embedding) AS raw_score,
                                (1 - (ce.embedding <=> query_embedding)) * vector_weight AS vector_score,
                                cm.season,
                                cm.episode,
                                cm.scene
                            FROM 
                                narrative_chunks nc
                            JOIN 
                                chunk_embeddings ce ON nc.id = ce.chunk_id
                            LEFT JOIN
                                chunk_metadata cm ON nc.id = cm.chunk_id
                            WHERE
                                ce.model = model_name
                            ORDER BY 
                                ce.embedding <=> query_embedding::vector
                            LIMIT 
                                k * 2
                        ),
                        text_results AS (
                            -- Text search
                            SELECT 
                                nc.id,
                                nc.raw_text AS text,
                                ts_rank(to_tsvector('english', nc.raw_text), 
                                      plainto_tsquery('english', query_text)) AS raw_score,
                                ts_rank(to_tsvector('english', nc.raw_text), 
                                      plainto_tsquery('english', query_text)) * text_weight AS text_score,
                                cm.season,
                                cm.episode,
                                cm.scene
                            FROM 
                                narrative_chunks nc
                            LEFT JOIN
                                chunk_metadata cm ON nc.id = cm.chunk_id
                            WHERE 
                                to_tsvector('english', nc.raw_text) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', query_text)
                            ORDER BY
                                ts_rank(to_tsvector('english', nc.raw_text), 
                                      plainto_tsquery('english', query_text)) DESC
                            LIMIT 
                                k * 2
                        ),
                        combined_results AS (
                            -- Combine and deduplicate results
                            SELECT 
                                COALESCE(v.id, t.id) AS id,
                                COALESCE(v.text, t.text) AS text,
                                COALESCE(v.vector_score, 0) AS vector_score,
                                COALESCE(t.text_score, 0) AS text_score,
                                CASE 
                                    -- When vector weight is 0, use only text score
                                    WHEN vector_weight = 0 THEN COALESCE(t.text_score, 0)
                                    -- When text weight is 0, use only vector score
                                    WHEN text_weight = 0 THEN COALESCE(v.vector_score, 0)
                                    -- Otherwise add them together
                                    ELSE COALESCE(v.vector_score, 0) + COALESCE(t.text_score, 0)
                                END AS combined_score,
                                COALESCE(v.season, t.season) AS season,
                                COALESCE(v.episode, t.episode) AS episode,
                                COALESCE(v.scene, t.scene) AS scene
                            FROM 
                                vector_results v
                            FULL OUTER JOIN 
                                text_results t ON v.id = t.id
                        )
                        SELECT *
                        FROM combined_results
                        ORDER BY combined_score DESC
                        LIMIT k;
                    END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hybrid_search(query_text text, query_embedding vector, vector_weight double precision, text_weight double precision, k integer, model_name text, alias_terms_input text[] DEFAULT ARRAY[]::text[])
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, text text, vector_score double precision, text_score double precision, combined_score double precision, season integer, episode integer, scene integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
                    DECLARE
                        alias_boost_factor FLOAT := 1.2; -- Use boost factor from settings
                    BEGIN
                        RETURN QUERY
                        WITH vector_results AS (
                            -- Vector search
                            SELECT 
                                nc.id,
                                nc.raw_text AS text,
                                1 - (ce.embedding <=> query_embedding) AS raw_score,
                                (1 - (ce.embedding <=> query_embedding)) * vector_weight AS vector_score,
                                cm.season,
                                cm.episode,
                                cm.scene
                            FROM 
                                narrative_chunks nc
                            JOIN 
                                chunk_embeddings ce ON nc.id = ce.chunk_id
                            LEFT JOIN
                                chunk_metadata cm ON nc.id = cm.chunk_id
                            WHERE
                                ce.model = model_name
                            ORDER BY 
                                ce.embedding <=> query_embedding::vector
                            LIMIT 
                                k * 2 -- Fetch more to allow for re-ranking/filtering
                        ),
                        text_results AS (
                            -- Text search
                            SELECT 
                                nc.id,
                                nc.raw_text AS text,
                                ts_rank(to_tsvector('english', nc.raw_text), 
                                      plainto_tsquery('english', query_text)) AS raw_score,
                                ts_rank(to_tsvector('english', nc.raw_text), 
                                      plainto_tsquery('english', query_text)) * text_weight AS text_score,
                                cm.season,
                                cm.episode,
                                cm.scene
                            FROM 
                                narrative_chunks nc
                            LEFT JOIN
                                chunk_metadata cm ON nc.id = cm.chunk_id
                            WHERE 
                                to_tsvector('english', nc.raw_text) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', query_text)
                            ORDER BY
                                raw_score DESC
                            LIMIT 
                                k * 2 -- Fetch more
                        ),
                        combined_results AS (
                            -- Combine and deduplicate results
                            SELECT 
                                COALESCE(v.id, t.id) AS id,
                                COALESCE(v.text, t.text) AS text,
                                COALESCE(v.vector_score, 0) AS vector_score,
                                COALESCE(t.text_score, 0) AS text_score,
                                -- Calculate base combined score
                                CASE 
                                    WHEN vector_weight = 0 THEN COALESCE(t.text_score, 0)
                                    WHEN text_weight = 0 THEN COALESCE(v.vector_score, 0)
                                    ELSE COALESCE(v.vector_score, 0) + COALESCE(t.text_score, 0)
                                END AS base_score,
                                -- Check if any alias term matches the text (case-insensitive)
                                CASE
                                    WHEN cardinality(alias_terms_input) > 0 AND EXISTS (
                                        SELECT 1
                                        FROM unnest(alias_terms_input) AS term
                                        WHERE COALESCE(v.text, t.text) ILIKE '%' || term || '%'
                                    ) THEN true
                                    ELSE false
                                END as alias_match,
                                COALESCE(v.season, t.season) AS season,
                                COALESCE(v.episode, t.episode) AS episode,
                                COALESCE(v.scene, t.scene) AS scene
                            FROM 
                                vector_results v
                            FULL OUTER JOIN 
                                text_results t ON v.id = t.id
                        )
                        SELECT 
                            combined_results.id,
                            combined_results.text,
                            combined_results.vector_score,
                            combined_results.text_score,
                            -- Apply boost if alias matched
                            combined_results.base_score * (CASE WHEN combined_results.alias_match THEN alias_boost_factor ELSE 1.0 END) AS combined_score,
                            combined_results.season,
                            combined_results.episode,
                            combined_results.scene
                        FROM combined_results
                        ORDER BY combined_score DESC
                        LIMIT k; -- Apply final limit
                    END;
                    $function$
